integrity: Exact analytic proof uses monomial orthogonality, holomorphic Rouché theorem, scalar implicit function, and radial moment expansion; the standalone checker only tests finite representative instances. No independent external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: For each fixed finite maximum added mass M>1/3, radius must be sufficiently small; only positive rotationally invariant measures. Neither nonsymmetric perturbations nor arbitrary mass at a fixed support radius are classified. Publication priority requires independent historical verification.
title: Universal moment law for the first Lu Qi-Keng zero created by concentrated radial mass
